$description: Authored. What a person heard at each splice; the analysis can't hear. A splice is keyed by the last song bar before it and the first after it; `edit` is the edit.json it was heard in. check fails on a negative verdict for the edit it was heard in, and asks for a re-listen once the edit has changed, or where nobody has listened yet.

verdicts.note: Drop 1 straight into the riser: the peak goes up again with no release. Bar-level and beat-level measures both rated it smooth.
Breakdown, riser and gap borrowed from the drop-2 build: 'all fucked up'. The breakdown is mid-section in other chords, and bar 52's gap is written to lead into drop 2, not the final chorus.

After the gap, no climax: 'just a normal beat'. The build kept its bass and nearly the drop's level, so the drop brought nothing new; the song has no impact hit of its own.
'There is no slam and the buildup is so fast, no anticipation.' The build lasted 1.75 bars and ended 1.5 LU under the drop; the bass return (+27.7 dB) is below what laptop and phone speakers play.
